project_context.name: Agent Dashboard Leaderboard Integration
project_context.description: This document contains all information needed to build a separate leaderboard display that syncs with the main Agent Dashboard
project_context.use_case: Display leaderboard on Smart TV or separate port/project

api_endpoint.update_frequency: Changes appear within 5 seconds of admin updates

agents.description: Array of agent objects with leaderboard data

rank.description: Current rank in leaderboard (1 = top performer)

profile_picture.description: Profile picture URL from REBS CRM

xp.description: Experience points (1 XP per euro of commission)

total_agents.description: Total number of agents in leaderboard

top_performer.description: Agent object for rank #1 (same structure as agents array items)

polling_interval.description: Poll API every 5-10 seconds for near real-time updates

error_handling.description: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff

cache_validation.description: Use If-None-Match header with ETag for efficient updates
cache_validation.benefit: Reduces bandwidth when data hasn't changed

etag_optimization.description: Using ETag for efficient cache validation

ranking.description: Agents ranked by total commission earned (highest first)

for_smart_tv.display_refresh: Update UI immediately when new data arrives
for_smart_tv.layout: Large, readable text for TV viewing distance

timeout.handling: Increase timeout or reduce polling frequency

testing_checklist.verify_error_handling: Test behavior when API is unavailable
testing_checklist.verify_sync: Add transaction in admin, verify it appears in display
testing_checklist.verify_performance: Ensure polling doesn't cause performance issues

important_notes: API reads directly from database - no cache on DB queries
Changes from admin dashboard appear within 5 seconds
Use polling interval of 5-10 seconds for best balance
ETag support allows efficient cache validation
CORS is enabled - can access from any origin
All monetary values are in EUR
XP and Level are calculated automatically
Avatar URLs may be null - provide fallback UI
next_steps: 1. Set API_BASE_URL to your dashboard server address
3. Create UI components to display agent data
4. Add error handling and retry logic
6. Optimize for Smart TV display (large text, clear layout)
